state: An unimplemented workflow-language draft contains Rent ResourcePolicy snapshots. Each locked capture has effective=now, increasing resource-local sequence and a value containing scalar resource policy plus every Window, Downtime, Booking and VenueReservation report value. Current source has 55 explicit capture sites; quote_accept captures after booking creation then again after its same-admission status change. The admission clock is fixed. Reports select the highest sequence effective at each time boundary, combine immutable LocationPolicy opening hours, and emit booked/occupied/saleable/excluded minutes with pooled units, frozen service intervals/buffers, actual arrival/departure and provisional open occupancy. Missing initial resource or opening evidence yields partial coverage, not zero. Resource reporting is a current reservation-manager/work-location-authorized authority read; saved rows themselves retain restricted grants. No ResourcePolicy retention is declared. One full booking-list capture per sequential booking creation stores B(B+1)/2 logical booking values; these are counts, not measured CPU or money. Same-transaction intermediate captures have no visible duration, but removal must verify no read/event/result consumes them before final capture. Automatic UI audit history exists but no typed historical-state query is declared. Existing models/locks/queries can represent smaller per-entity revisions explicitly, provided every mutation site captures changed identities and report reconstruction preserves absence/ordering/coverage. No compiler compatibility constraint exists. Compare equivalent historical outputs including cancellation, late checkout, changed capacity, DST, missing history and unchanged billing/currency/reversal semantics. Do not solve growth by silently expiring history or reading current mutable rows.

history.instructions: Which complete representation best meets the equal report and confidentiality requirements?

criteria.explicit_facts: Use ordinary locked per-entity revisions for windows, downtime, bookings and venues plus a small resource-policy capture sequence. Every affected mutation explicitly appends its changed entity value and marks the resource capture; reports reconstruct the latest value per stable entity at the selected capture. Preserve an explicit baseline/absence boundary and current grants. This removes unrelated collection copying but adds capture-site bookkeeping and temporal joins that must be checked.
criteria.version_query: Specify a new typed transaction-final historical-version query over declared report fields using canonical version history. Compiler/runtime capture mutations once and reports read as-of state with defined ordering, retention, disclosure and completeness. It centralizes capture responsibility and can reduce app repetition, but adds a broad temporal API, selective retention semantics and implementation obligations absent from current audit UI.
criteria.full_coalesced: Retain full explicit snapshots and reports, deleting only proven unobserved intermediate captures inside one admission. Stable complete values keep reconstruction simple and preserve old history without new APIs. Growing collections continue to be copied across transactions; count and budget this retained work rather than claiming the coalescing fixes that growth.
